messages:
incident-bot: ALERT: spike in 401s from auth-edge-introspect (region: us-west-2). Threshold breached: 5xx/4xx error ratio > 30% for 3m. Paging @alice_oncall :rotating_light:

alice_oncall: got the page, looking now. seeing an alert dashboard showing a jump starting ~08:13 UTC. Any user-facing reports?

bob_sre: checking logs, we have thousands of /introspect 401s where signature verification fails with 'token not found' and 'kid mismatch'. appears correlated with edge cache TTL churn.

carol_idp: we did a config push to edge cache invalidation earlier this morning (08:00) to shorten jwks TTL to 30s during a rotation test. rolling back now.

frank_infra: can you confirm the change id? I see a deploy-bot message:

deploy-bot: deploy completed: infra/edge/jwks-cache#r12345 by carol_idp at 2026-03-15T08:02:11Z

alice_oncall: ok timeline matches. if edges are aggressively invalidating, some nodes may be serving stale cached state while others fetch newer keys -> transient kid mismatches. That would explain the spike in 401s.

dave_support: customer support is getting multiple tickets: login failures and console access blocked for some customers. We need a message to customers ASAP and a mitigation plan.

erin_product: impact estimate? are internal console logins affected or only customer-facing auth flows?

bob_sre: both. Auth middleware uses introspect for sessions; stale jwks -> backend rejects tokens -> service returns 401, which blocks console and API access. Rate is ~18% of auth checks in US-WEST at peak.

alice_oncall: mitigation options: 1) revert the jwks-cache TTL change (fast) 2) temporarily route auth-edge to central jwks fetcher (reduce stale variance) 3) enable a permissive fallback: accept last-known-good keys for 60s while we stabilize. Thoughts?

carol_idp: I've initiated a rollback of infra/edge/jwks-cache to previous commit r12340 (TTL 300s). rolling back now, ETA ~2m.

frank_infra: I'm standing up a bypass proxy to central jwks (to reduce per-edge fetch races) as a short-term. Pushing config to load-balancer to route introspect to central verifier cluster. Will take ~5m to propagate.

alice_oncall: executing rollback now. I'll monitor error rates.

[~2 minutes later]

bob_sre: metrics: 401 rate dropped from 18% to 6% after rollback started. still noisy but trending down.

dave_support: sending customer update: "We observed intermittent login failures due to an edge configuration change affecting token verification. We rolled back the configuration and are monitoring — customers may see restored access within minutes. We'll follow up with RCA."

erin_product: please flag any customers still impacted (top-20) so we can escalate individually.

carol_idp: rollback completed at 08:17 UTC. Confirmed commit r12340 deployed to all edges.

bob_sre: 401 rate down to baseline (~0.5%) at 08:22 UTC. Looks stable.

alice_oncall: beginning incident timeline and initial notes. Severity: P1 (customer-facing auth failures + console blocked). Incident lead: alice_oncall.

frank_infra: putting a temporary guardrail: block automated jwks TTL pushes without a canary window + automatic rate-limiter on cache invalidations. I'll open a PR.

deploy-bot: rollback executed: infra/edge/jwks-cache r12340 -> SUCCESS by carol_idp at 2026-03-15T08:17:03Z

dave_support: support triage: created ticket bundle for top affected customers, messaged CS to offer direct assistance.

erin_product: we should prepare a short post-incident note and coordinate with comms; also check SLOs for login success over last 24h.

alice_oncall: handing off monitoring to bob_sre for the rest of the shift. If metrics remain stable for 1h, we'll move to P0->P2 and start RCA. Handoff notes:
- cause: aggressive jwks cache invalidation rollout (edge) caused key skew across edge nodes -> token kid mismatch -> 401s
- mitigation: rollback to previous jwks TTL (300s) + central jwks proxy as fallback + guardrail PR
- customer impact: intermittent login failures and console access issues for subset of customers in us-west-2, resolved within ~20 minutes for most
- next steps: RCA with idp and infra, add unit/integration test for jwks invalidation race, improved canary for infra changes

bob_sre: ack, I'll monitor and start RCA doc. tagging carol_idp and frank_infra for follow-up.

carol_idp: noted. I will open a postmortem draft and include the config diff + deploy timeline.

alice_oncall: incident declared resolved at 08:40 UTC and handed off. Closing the page. :white_check_mark:

[~14 hours later]

alice_oncall: post-incident note appended: we owe customers a short explanation and a commit to better canarying. Also adding a test that simulates concurrent jwks invalidations across edge fleet.

erin_product: thanks all — please drop the RCA link here when ready so PMs can review customer comms before we send an update.

end of thread
